q = sql("select count(*) as n, sum(case when dlydelflg='Y' then 1 else 0 end) as ndel, sum(case when dlydelflg='Y' and dlyret is not null then 1 else 0 end) as ndelret from crsp.dsf_v2 where dlycaldt between '2015-01-01' and '2015-12-31'")
out('dsf_v2 2015 rows, delisting-day rows, delisting rows with a return:', int(q.n[0]), int(q.ndel[0]), int(q.ndelret[0]))
q = sql("select securitytype, securitysubtype, sharetype, usincflg, count(distinct permno) as n from crsp.stksecurityinfohist where secinfoenddt >= '2020-01-01' group by 1,2,3,4 order by n desc limit 15")
out('security type combos (count of permnos):')
for r in q.itertuples(): out('  ', r.securitytype, r.securitysubtype, r.sharetype, r.usincflg, int(r.n))
q = sql("select ticker, count(distinct permno) as n from crsp.stksecurityinfohist where ticker in ('SPY','IWM') and secinfoenddt >= '2012-01-01' group by ticker")
for r in q.itertuples(): out('ETF ticker', r.ticker, 'permnos', int(r.n))
